use_step_profiler_context_manager: use StepProfiler as a context manager to measure and report processing time of a method step to Prometheus
use_long_step_profiler: use LongStepProfiler context manager to profile long-running method steps with custom histogram buckets
get_prometheus_latest_content: call getLatestContent on a Prometheus instance to retrieve the current metrics as a UTF-8 string
update_queue_jobs_total_metric: call update_queue_jobs_total to sync the QUEUE_JOBS_TOTAL gauge with the latest job metrics from the database
update_disk_usage_gauge: call update_disk_gauge with a Gauge and directory path to report disk usage metrics to Prometheus
